svg.title: How a quiet rotor fault unfolds
svg.desc: Illustrative trace, not flight data. Rotor 3 thrust drops to 70 percent and PX4's built-in failure detector stays silent. A GRU ensemble flags the fault 0.88 seconds later. The learned policy slows down and completes the mission, while a land-on-detection controller ends the mission at the moment of detection.

g.text: A rotor loses 30% of its thrust. PX4 stays silent.
A GRU ensemble flags the fault; the PPO mission policy slows down, holds altitude and finishes the mission.
At 20–35% thrust loss the learned policy finished 98% of missions, against 29% for land-on-detection.
